answer: Re-attestations are stored in quartz and glacier lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the harbor graph. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 5 epochs, which means holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 1372 identities would post 4540 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
